editorial.description_en: A clear cold sky with no depth in it — light, cool, and low in chroma.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の晴れた空のような、つめたい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.760, C 0.034, h 250.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 寒 (samu, cold) + 空 (sora, sky), rendaku to -zora. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Cold Sky" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 寒空. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — to-yama at ΔE00 4.5, yuki-kage at ΔE00 4.6, ame-ishi at ΔE00 4.9. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.034 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
